ios.desc:
Gobble: Replace endless scrolling with language learning

Boost your productivity and language learning journey with Gobble! We combine app blocking with language acquisition, empowering you to focus on your goals while expanding your vocabulary in your target language. Go Cold Turkey on Your Apps Now!

TRANSFORM PROCRASTINATION INTO PROGRESS

Are you tired of constantly battling the urge to check social media or play games? Gobble turns this challenge into an opportunity for growth. Block any distracting apps and unblock them by reviewing a few flashcards. You will learn thousands of new words in no time.

BENEFITS:
- Reduce stress
- Stay more focused
- Use your phone more consciously
- Learn thousands of words

KEY FEATURES:
1. Customizable App Blocking: Easily select and block the apps that steal your attention.
2. Learn to Unlock: Review flashcards to regain access to your blocked apps.
3. Intelligent Notifications: If you attempt to open a blocked app, Gobble gently reminds you to return and review your flashcards.
4. Cutting-edge Spaced Repetition: Our advanced algorithm presents words for review at the optimal moment, just before you're likely to forget them.
5. Diverse Language Options: Choose from various languages to learn and expand your vocabulary.

HOW COLD TURKEY WORKS:
1. Set Your Boundaries: Begin by selecting the apps you find most distracting. These could be social media, games, or any apps that often derail your productivity.
2. Embrace the Learning Challenge: Whenever you feel the urge to use a blocked app, Gobble gives you an opportunity to learn. Review a set of flashcards in your target language to unlock your apps.
3. Effortless Vocabulary Expansion: As you consistently use Gobble, you'll find yourself naturally absorbing new words in your chosen language.
4. Optimize Your Learning: Our Spaced Repetition Algorithm ensures that words are reviewed at the perfect intervals, maximizing your retention and learning efficiency.
5. Track Your Progress: Watch as your productivity soars and your language skills improve simultaneously. Gobble provides insights into your learning patterns and productivity trends.

You can block any apps such as:
- Facebook
- Tiktok
- Instagram
- Netflix
- Tinder
- And many more!

PERFECT FOR:
- Students looking to balance study time with language learning
- Professionals aiming to boost productivity while acquiring new language skills
- Language enthusiasts seeking a unique and effective way to expand their voc

show_hn.title: Show HN: I made an iOS app blocker that helps you learn new words

quotes.text:
Hello HN!

I created Gobble, an iOS app designed to block distracting apps until you complete your flashcard reviews.

I’ve been learning languages on and off for the last 10 years, and one of my favorite activities is reviewing flashcards. I know this can be a huge drain, but it is a highly efficient way to learn new words [0].

Flashcards aren't a silver bullet, but I find that I can review hundreds of them if I break the sessions into shorter intervals throughout the day. The problem with reviewing flashcards on my phone, though, is that while it's an amazing tool, it’s also incredibly easy to get distracted by other apps.

Right now, the app includes the full N5 Japanese vocab list, as well as basic content for French and Spanish, with more content on the way.

I'd love to hear your feedback!

[0] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spaced_repetition
